breakdown.description: The prompt sets the support slopes to zero by symmetry, but for a simply supported beam under a midspan point load the slope is zero at midspan, not at the supports.
breakdown.reason: The known error was the incorrect statement that support slopes are zero. In the generated specification, that incorrect constraint is removed; it only states deflection is zero at supports and asks to compute slope at supports, which is consistent with the corrected/ground-truth version.
